strategy_reasoning: The headline is driven by short-term price momentum and speculative targets ($0.20 XLM), which offers no architectural wedge for credit infrastructure.
Vanna is on testnet and governed by strict guidelines against asserting live TVL or price speculation.
A weak or off-brand post piggybacking on token price hype costs more in protocol credibility than passing on the signal.
reason: The signal focuses primarily on retail token price speculation ('XLM Bulls Eye $0.20') and generic ecosystem TVL growth. Vanna operates strictly on testnet, does not engage in secondary market price commentary, and gains no differentiated architectural wedge from retail price momentum.
